title: Introduce KMS exposure minimizer and audit lifecycle annotator
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Reduce KMS key material exposure in high-throughput paths and add structured audit metadata that tracks lifecycle events (provision, lease, revocation, retention) for compliance reporting. This PR implements a lightweight KMS proxy that tokenizes key handles before they travel through service meshes and introduces an audit lifecycle annotator that writes compact, retention-aware audit records suitable for downstream compliance pipelines. The design reduces plaintext KMS identifiers in transit, provides short-lived escrow leases for operator actions, and surfaces TTL/retention hints for audit backends. Scope: - Add 'exposure minimizer' middleware that replaces raw key ARN/ID strings with ephemeral handles bound to operator session leases. - Implement escrowed proxy component that can vouch for a token and forward a limited set of KMS operations (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey) to configured KMS backends; proxies are pinned per-region to satisfy data residency controls. - Add 'audit lifecycle annotator' that attaches canonical lifecycle labels (action, lease_id, retention_hint_ms, residency_zone) to existing audit events and emits a compact JSON envelope to the audit queue. - Wire RBAC v2 checks in the proxy to validate operator role templates and deny cross-region key usage unless explicit residency consent is present. - Tests: unit tests for lease revocation and token rotation, integration tests exercising regional pinning and audit envelope emission, and e2e run in staging overlay. Checklist: - [x] Implementation of middleware and proxy - [x] RBAC v2 integration and denylist check - [x] Audit envelope schema and annotator - [x] Unit and integration tests - [x] Docs + console surface notes - [x] Security scan and fuzzing pass Backwards compatibility: The middleware is opt-in via service config (kms.exposure_minimizer.enabled=false by default) and falls back to current behavior when disabled. Migration: Operators can enable the proxy per-cluster; when enabled, a background job rotates ephemeral leases and emits migration markers to allow downstream audit processors to attribute previously-unannotated records. See linked Linear items for rollout plan and staged rollout steps. Runtime considerations: The proxy keeps a small in-memory lease map (TTL cache) and batches attestations to the audit producer to avoid per-request amplification. Latency impact measured in local benchmarks: median +4ms for a single Encrypt call with tokenization enabled; batching reduces amortized cost under high throughput. Security considerations: - Ephemeral handles are HMAC-signed tokens with KMS-wrapped secret; tokens expire quickly (default 30s) and support immediate revocation via lease revocation endpoint. - Proxy runs with least privilege KMS keys scoped per-region and logs only canonicalized audit envelopes (no raw plaintext key IDs). - RBAC v2 checks use attribute-driven templates; missing residency claims cause explicit deny and generate an audit event for policy exceptions. Related work: Links to infra/linters, Linear tasks ENG-4453, security advisory SEC-118, and SUP-7321 support ticket for customer residency questions. Impacted components: serving runtime (minimal hooks), api-gateway (middleware), pkg/kms (new proxy), pkg/audit (annotator), console docs and runtime config. Merge notes: squash merge with integration test artifacts archived in build system; follow-up PR will add console toggles for enforcement and a migration tool for audit processors.

review_comments: Liam Novak: Please add a unit test that simulates immediate lease revocation and asserts token rejection (found a missing path in lease_manager).

release_notes: Added optional KMS exposure minimizer and audit lifecycle annotator. Opt-in via kms.exposure_minimizer.enabled flag. Provides ephemeral key-handle tokenization, regional pinning, RBAC v2 deny on cross-region usage without consent, and compact audit envelopes with retention hints for compliance pipelines. No breaking changes by default.
notes_for_ops: When enabling in production: 1) enable in a single region and monitor audit stream for 'migration_marker' envelopes; 2) ensure audit processors understand 'retention_hint_ms' and 'residency_zone'; 3) monitor lease_manager cache hit rate and tune token TTL (default 30s). For rollback: disable kms.exposure_minimizer.enabled and restart api-gateway workers.
risk_assessment: Low-medium: opt-in feature that adds a networked proxy component; main risks are operational complexity and transient latency. Mitigations: opt-in rollout, unit/integration tests, TTL tuning, and explicit RBAC deny to avoid accidental cross-region access.
post_merge_actions: Coordinate with console team to add toggle and retention docs
Publish migration markers to audit processors and confirm mapping
